name: Screen Replacement
description: Replacement of broken, cracked, or malfunctioning phone screens.
details: The damaged display is removed and replaced with a compatible screen. The device is tested after installation.

name: Battery Replacement
description: Replacement for batteries with poor performance or charging problems.
details: Battery condition is evaluated before replacement and the device is tested after the new battery is installed.

name: Charging Port Repair
description: Diagnosis and repair of phones that do not charge correctly.
details: The charging connector and related components are inspected to determine whether cleaning, repair, or replacement is required.

name: Speaker Repair
description: Solutions for low, distorted, or missing sound from the phone speaker.
details: The speaker and related components are inspected and tested to identify the cause of the audio problem.

name: Microphone Repair
description: Repair for devices with poor or missing microphone audio.
details: Microphones and related components are tested to diagnose problems affecting calls, recordings, or voice messages.

name: Camera Repair
description: Diagnosis and replacement of malfunctioning front or rear cameras.
details: Camera modules and their connections are inspected when the camera does not focus, open, or produce a clear image.

name: Device Diagnostics
description: General inspection to identify hardware problems and possible repair options.
details: The device is evaluated to identify the source of a problem before a repair procedure is recommended.

name: Software Troubleshooting
description: Diagnosis of software errors, crashes, and general system problems.
details: Software-related issues are evaluated to determine possible solutions without unnecessarily replacing hardware.

name: System Update Assistance
description: Assistance with compatible operating system updates and related issues.
details: The device and current software version are reviewed before performing or troubleshooting an available system update.

name: Device Setup
description: Basic configuration assistance for smartphones and common applications.
details: Help with essential device settings, application configuration, and general setup after a reset or device change.

name: Phone Cases
description: Protective cases available for different smartphone models.
details: Different styles and models may be available depending on current inventory.

name: Screen Protectors
description: Protective glass for compatible smartphone screens.
details: Screen protectors help reduce scratches and everyday damage to the device display.

name: Chargers
description: Charging adapters for compatible mobile devices.
details: Available charger types vary according to connector, charging requirements, and current inventory.

name: USB Cables
description: Charging and data cables for different mobile device connections.
details: Cable availability may include USB-C, Lightning, Micro-USB, and other commonly used connections.

name: Headphones
description: Wired and wireless audio options for compatible devices.
details: Available models and connection types vary according to current inventory.

name: Phone Speakers
description: Portable Bluetooth speakers for music and everyday use.
details: Different portable speaker models may be available depending on current inventory.
